_comment: FH51/FH55. Photo manifest for the five Microsoft keynote speakers on /events/convergence/. Official-source-only headshots (Microsoft blog author pages, Ignite 2026 speaker pages, news.microsoft.com) were searched for; LinkedIn and other third-party sites are explicitly excluded per the prompt. FH55 (2026-11-24) found real, usable official portraits for 3 of 5: Bryan Goode (Power Platform Blog author page, WordPress Person schema headshot), Deva Rajamohan (Dynamics 365 Blog author page, WordPress Person schema headshot), and Georg Glantschnig (Dynamics 365 Blog author page, WordPress Person schema headshot, credited to Microsoft photographer Brian Smale). Note: both Bryan Goode's and Deva Rajamohan's individual Ignite 2026 speaker pages only exposed a generic text/graphic 'View my sessions' card image via og:image (no real face) -- those were correctly rejected as not a usable portrait and the official blog author-page photos were used instead. Jeff Teper and Rashida Hodge remain on initials: no official source (Ignite speaker page, relevant Microsoft blog author page, or news.microsoft.com exec bio) returned a usable portrait for either within this session's tooling; both are listed under 'Needs Nick' in Scout_Report_FH55.md. photo is null for both until a verified official headshot is supplied.
